LAGUNAK.Ajustes.Url.Pista: Address of the integration bridge (e.g. http://localhost:8090). Local to this browser; never shared with players.
LAGUNAK.Ajustes.Token.Pista: Hidden legacy setting; the active token lives in memory for this session only.
LAGUNAK.Ajustes.Intervalo.Pista: How often the ship state is fetched, in seconds.
LAGUNAK.Ajustes.DecoradoSemilla.Pista: Determines the sky, nebulae, planets and asteroid backdrop of the live map. Same value for everyone (world setting). Type your own number, or use the dice button in the scene controls for a random one.
LAGUNAK.Controles.DecoradoAleatorio: New random live map background (Espaciokoop Lagunak)
LAGUNAK.Token.Intro: Paste the bridge token. It is kept in memory only until this tab is reloaded or closed.
LAGUNAK.Token.EstadoConfigurado: A token is loaded for this session. The field remains empty to avoid revealing it.
LAGUNAK.Token.EstadoVacio: No token is loaded in this session.
LAGUNAK.Token.Configurado: Token loaded in memory for this session only.
LAGUNAK.Token.ErrorMigracion: The legacy token setting could not be cleared. Remove it manually from this site's storage before continuing.
LAGUNAK.Token.ErrorVentana: The token window could not be opened. No secret was loaded.
LAGUNAK.Token.ErrorCierre: The token was revoked, but Foundry could not close its window. The sensitive field was cleared.
LAGUNAK.Diagnostico.Ok: Bridge reachable and token authorized. All set.
LAGUNAK.Diagnostico.SinUrl: Bridge URL is missing. Set it in the module settings.
LAGUNAK.Diagnostico.SinToken: The bridge responds, but the session token is missing. Copy it from the install wizard and use “Configure bridge token”.
LAGUNAK.Diagnostico.TokenInvalido: The bridge responds, but rejects the session token. Copy it and configure it again.
LAGUNAK.Diagnostico.Inaccesible: Could not reach the bridge. Check that the stack is up, the URL setting, and that BRIDGE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS includes this browser's exact origin.
LAGUNAK.Diagnostico.ErrorPuente: The bridge responds, but /v1/state failed for a reason other than the token. Check the bridge logs.
LAGUNAK.Puestos.IntroJugador: Choose your station for this crew. The game master can correct the assignment.
LAGUNAK.Puestos.IntroGM: Assign or correct any player's station.
LAGUNAK.Puestos.SinJugadores: There are no player users in this world.
LAGUNAK.Puestos.NoPermitido: You cannot change that player's station.
LAGUNAK.Puestos.ErrorGuardado: The station could not be saved. The previous assignment remains active.
LAGUNAK.MapaVivo.SinDatos: No contacts from the bridge yet.
LAGUNAK.Diario.Anotado: Status written to the ship's log.
LAGUNAK.Encuentros.Introducido: Encounter injected: the crew will see it on their sensors.
LAGUNAK.Encuentros.SinNave: There is no player ship in the simulation.
LAGUNAK.Encuentros.NoSoportado: The loaded scenario does not support GM encounters.
LAGUNAK.Encuentros.Fallo: The bridge could not inject the encounter.
LAGUNAK.Ingenieria.Aceptada: Power order accepted; the observed level will update with the next telemetry poll.
LAGUNAK.Ingenieria.Nota: Distributes power per system; normal repair remains the crew's job at their engineering station.
LAGUNAK.Maniobra.SinNave: There is no ship to command.
LAGUNAK.Maniobra.Fallo: The bridge could not run the order.
LAGUNAK.Maniobra.Nota: Quick GM orders bypassing the crew stations; time acceleration is pending game API.
LAGUNAK.Reposicion.Hecha: Ship repositioned: the crew will appear next to the chosen anchor.
LAGUNAK.Reposicion.SinNave: There is no player ship in the simulation.
LAGUNAK.Reposicion.NoSoportado: The loaded scenario does not support repositioning the ship.
LAGUNAK.Reposicion.Fallo: The bridge could not reposition the ship.
LAGUNAK.Eventos.Llegada.Resumen: The ship has arrived at {destination}. Scenario time: {elapsed} s.
LAGUNAK.Eventos.Reposicion.Resumen: The game master repositioned the ship next to {anchor}. Scenario time: {elapsed} s.
LAGUNAK.Eventos.Encuentro.Resumen: A {archetype} contact appeared with call sign {callsign}. Scenario time: {elapsed} s.
LAGUNAK.Eventos.Anotados: New event written to the ship's log.
LAGUNAK.Alertas.Anotadas: New ship alert written to the ship's log.
LAGUNAK.Errores.SinEstado: There is no ship state to log.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.TelemetriaRestringida: Crew console · telemetry restricted to the game master
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.RumboAyuda: Degrees 0–359. The order is relayed through the game master.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.ImpulsoAyuda: From −1 (reverse) to 1 (forward). The order is relayed through the game master.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.WarpAyuda: Integer level from 0 to 4. The order is relayed through the game master.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.WarpInvalido: Enter an integer warp level between 0 and 4.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.PotenciaAyuda: Distributes power per system (0–3, 1 is nominal). The order is relayed through the game master.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.PotenciaInvalida: Choose a valid system and power level.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.RefrigeranteAyuda: Distributes coolant per system (0–10). The order is relayed through the game master.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.RefrigeranteInval: Choose a valid system and coolant level.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.EscudosAyuda: Raise or lower shields. The order is relayed through the game master.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.EscudosInvalido: Could not compose the shields order.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.RumboInvalido: Enter a heading between 0 and 359 degrees.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.Enviada: Heading order sent to the bridge.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.SinTelemetriaDetalle: Your station, crew and watch list are available. Sensitive telemetry is only shown to the game master connected to the bridge.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.SinPuestoDetalle: You need a crew station to open your workspace. You can change it later; the game master can also correct it.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.captain.Tarea.Situacion: Review confirmed hull, energy, shields and route.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.captain.Tarea.Prioridad: Set one clear priority for the watch.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.captain.Tarea.Coordinac: Confirm that every station is covered.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.navigation.Tarea.Rumbo: Cross-check heading and speed before reporting.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.navigation.Tarea.Ruta: Monitor destination and position without extrapolating.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.engineering.Tarea.Tempe: Spot heat peaks before the alarm.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.engineering.Tarea.Repar: Prioritise damaged systems with the crew.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.sensors.Tarea.Barrido: Maintain the sweep and check if it is truncated.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.sensors.Tarea.Identific: Keep observed contact separate from confirmed identity.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.sensors.Tarea.Seguimien: Report changes without inventing hostile intent.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.communications.Tarea.Me: Repeat critical orders and confirm receipt.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.weapons.Tarea.Solucione: Prepare solutions from confirmed contacts only.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.weapons.Tarea.Confirmac: Require explicit confirmation before any action.
LAGUNAK.MapaVivo.Descripcion: Tactical map of contacts around the ship
LAGUNAK.Pausa.Error: The last order failed; you can retry
LAGUNAK.Pausa.FoundryPausado: Foundry is paused (independent from the simulator; they do not sync).
LAGUNAK.Ayuda.EstadoQueEs: Live telemetry of the ship simulated by Espaciokoop Lagunak: position, heading, destination, hull, energy and systems.
LAGUNAK.Ayuda.MapaQueEs: Sensor view centred on your own ship (the fixed dot in the middle). Each coloured dot is a nearby object; the contact list below shows the same data as text.
LAGUNAK.Ayuda.SoloLectura: This window is read-only: the ship is not piloted from here.
LAGUNAK.Ayuda.Navegacion: Navigation is handled from the helm station of the Espaciokoop game itself (playable tutorial in its main menu). Foundry carries the story; the simulator owns the ship.
LAGUNAK.MapaVivo.LeyendaParpadeo: Contacts blink; your own ship stays fixed at the centre.
LAGUNAK.MapaVivo.SinSeleccion: Tap a contact in the list to see its type, faction, distance and bearing.
LAGUNAK.Tempo.Discordante: The simulator does not reflect the pause command: check its state.
LAGUNAK.Controles.AudioMusica: Enable or mute audio on this machine (Espaciokoop Lagunak)
LAGUNAK.Musica.Auto: Automatic music, following the alert level
LAGUNAK.Musica.Registro.auto: Automatic music, following the alert level
LAGUNAK.Puestos.Requisitos.SinFicha: You need an assigned character to take a station.
LAGUNAK.Ajustes.Requisitos.Nombre: Require ability scores to take a station
LAGUNAK.Ajustes.Requisitos.Pista: When enabled, each station asks for a minimum score in one of its abilities (engineering asks for Intelligence or Wisdom, weapons for Dexterity or Strength, and so on). The GM is exempt and can always reassign anyone. It is a way to organise the table, not a hard barrier.
LAGUNAK.Ajustes.RequisitosMinimo.Pista: Only applies when the above is enabled. 12 is «above average» without being a filter.
LAGUNAK.Minijuegos.Ajustes.Mesa.Pista: Chips each player sits down with, and the blind values. Applies to the next hand, not the one in progress.
LAGUNAK.Ajustes.Idioma.Pista: Language for Lagunak's texts on THIS client, independent of Foundry's language. "Automatic" follows Foundry.
LAGUNAK.Ajustes.Idioma.NoCargado: The module language could not be loaded; keeping the previous one.
LAGUNAK.Minijuegos.Mesa.SinMesa: No table is open. The GM sets it up.
LAGUNAK.Minijuegos.Mesa.ManoCancelada: The hand was cancelled: the table went back to how it was before the deal.
LAGUNAK.Minijuegos.Mesa.ImporteInvalido: Say how much you raise to: a number of chips.
LAGUNAK.Minijuegos.Mesa.Rechazada: The table did not accept the play: {motivo}
LAGUNAK.Minijuegos.Rechazo.epoca_obsolet: the table changed hands; try again
LAGUNAK.Minijuegos.Rechazo.revision_obso: the table moved while you decided; try again
LAGUNAK.Minijuegos.Rechazo.sin_identidad: the table could not tell who is playing
LAGUNAK.Minijuegos.Rechazo.no_autorizado: that is not yours to do
LAGUNAK.Minijuegos.Rechazo.ya_en_mesa: you are already at the table
LAGUNAK.Minijuegos.Rechazo.no_participa: you are not at the table
LAGUNAK.Minijuegos.Rechazo.sin_semilla: the deck could not be shuffled
LAGUNAK.Minijuegos.Rechazo.nonce_reutili: that play had already been sent
LAGUNAK.Minijuegos.Rechazo.juego_rechazo: the game does not allow that play
LAGUNAK.Minijuegos.Rechazo.sin_modulo: the module has not finished starting up
